items.title: Xiaomi 50W Wireless Car Charger Kit (MDY-17-EZ) Auto-Clamp Holder
items.description:
Genuine Xiaomi 50W wireless car charger kit (China version). Box opened (unboxed) only – never really used, everything new and complete. Selling because it is too small for my Pro Max-size phone.

ဗူးဖောက်ရုံသာ၊ မသုံးရသေးတဲ့ စစ်မှန်တဲ့ Xiaomi 50W ကားသုံး ကြိုးမဲ့အားသွင်း ဖုန်းကိုင်ပါ။
Xiaomi ဖုန်း (50W ရတဲ့မော်ဒယ်) ဆို 50W အမြန်အားသွင်းရပါတယ်။ iPhone/Samsung က ပုံမှန်နှုန်းနဲ့ အားသွင်းပါတယ်။

In the box: charger/holder, car adapter (12–24V, cable attached), stick-on base, 2 air-vent mounts, silicone spacer pad, manual.

Specs:
• Model: MDY-17-EZ (launched Sept 2024)
• Output: 50W max wireless
• Input: DC 12–24V or USB-C 5–20V 3.25A
• Car adapter: 12–24V in (car or truck), 1.5m DC cable, extra USB-A port 5V 2A
• Motorized auto-clamp with infrared sensor + touch keys; clamps still open for ~30 min after power-off
• Built-in cooling fan, blue ring light
• Size ~116 × 72 mm, ~164 g
• Phone case: non-metal, 4 mm thick or less

Notes: full 50W only on supported Xiaomi phones (e.g. Xiaomi Ultra / Pro series). iPhone, Samsung and other Qi phones charge at normal wireless speed. May not fit very large phones like Pro Max. Manual is in Chinese.
